setting: You are all dog walkers at the same park in Glasgow, Scotland, where you live, and you have walked dogs there for a few years, so you recognise each other by sight and by your dogs. You know each other's names and a little about each other's work and families, and you share a group chat for arranging walks and swapping news about the dogs.
opener: Send a photo of a muddy dog at the park gate and ask who's around this morning.

Morag.knows: You know Duncan as the older man with the grandchildren who walks a scruffy terrier on weekday mornings. You know Adam as the young student who walks several dogs at once and is always in a hurry.
Morag.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a dog has gone missing or a walk has been cancelled.
Morag.style: a few kisses and dog emoji, such as 🐶 and x, with abbreviations like "thx" now and then.

Duncan.knows: You know Morag as the primary teacher with the collie cross who always has a tennis ball in her pocket. You know Adam as the vet nursing student who walks dogs to pay for his studies and is polite to you.
Duncan.texts: You rarely message the group unless someone asks you something, and you mostly reply when others post.

Adam.knows: You know Morag as the teacher who walks her collie and is always friendly. You know Duncan as the older man with the terrier who gives you tips about the dogs.
Adam.texts: You message the group quite often, mostly sending photos of the dogs you are walking.
Adam.style: lots of emoji and abbreviations like "tbh", "lol" and "ur".

private_lines.Morag: You teach Primary 4 at a primary school on Glasgow's south side, so your weekdays are busy with lessons and marking. You walk your collie cross before and after work and pick up a few extra walks at weekends for pocket money. You live in a flat with your partner, and your days are steady and tiring, with most of your evenings spent cooking and catching up on planning.
private_lines.Duncan: You are retired from a career in engineering, and you mind your grandchildren on Tuesdays and Thursdays at their parents' house. The rest of your week is quiet, with a walk in the park most mornings and the odd trip to the shops. You live with your wife, and your days follow a slow, settled routine.
private_lines.Adam: You are a university student studying veterinary nursing in Glasgow, so your days are split between lectures, placements at a vet practice, and studying late. You share a flat with two other students and walk dogs around the park for extra cash between classes. Your schedule is irregular, and you spend a lot of time on your phone.

text:
[photo: a collie cross, muddy to the shoulders, at the park gate]
who's about this morning? She's been in the burn 🐶
Here. Terrier's had a roll in something he shouldn't have. I'll be by the bench till quarter past eight.
Ha. See you there. I've got 25 mins before school
Bring a towel for the back seat.

[photo: a spaniel asleep in a car]
sorry just up 😩 lectures till 4 today. can anyone do mrs henderson's westie at 5? ur lol
Just out of school. I can do the westie if no one else, I'm at the gate by 5:15 🐶x
omg ur a legend 😭🙏 tbh i owe u one. she's nice btw, eats leaves
Grandchildren are home so I can do the usual at six if anyone wants company. Terrier needs a wander.
Ok see u at 5:15 duncan 🐶

[photo: a three-legged cat on a vet's counter]
placement today. she was called Biscuit and she had the best time tbh lol 😻

[photo: a collie cross on a frosty path, looking unimpressed]
too cold for the burn today 🐶
Frost on the bench. Terrier wore his coat.
Did Mrs Henderson's westie behave for you last night?
She did. Ate a leaf at the gate then sat down in a puddle 😂

[photo: two terriers asleep in the same dog bed]
sorry was asleep 😭 can anyone do the 3 o'clock lab tmrw? ur lol
Can't tmrw, parents' evening. Duncan?
Grandchildren Thursdays till five. Sorry.
ok ill find someone tbh. thx anyway 🙏
Parents' evening done. Never again 😩
still no one for the 3 o clock lab?? lol 🙏
Bench is wet. Terrier's not impressed.

[photo: collie cross standing in a shallow burn, tail up]
she's back in it 🐶
sorry up. 3 o clock lab is still uncovered 😭 asking the girls in my flat
I can do the lab if no one else. Out at 3:15, could be at the gate for 4ish?
ur the best tbh 😭🙏 its a lab called rufus. he eats socks
[photo: a yellow lab with a sock hanging from its mouth]
Ha. Ok I'll keep my eye on the socks 🐶
Frost tonight. Tell Rufus to wear a jumper.

[photo: a sign on the vet practice door reading "CLOSED - SEE YOU MONDAY"]
placement finished early lol
